verdict.rationale: Gusto's official MCP server and CLI provide OAuth2-based connections with selectable data categories per connection, and the CLI supports scoped env-based credential slots (production vs sandbox), token-stdin for secret hygiene, and a confirm-gated write model limiting agent actions — all evidencing least-privilege, scoped credential issuance for agents. missing for 10: no explicit fine-grained permission/role scoping model (e.g., read-only vs write-only token grants) documented beyond category selection and env slots, and no independent/hands-on verification of the scoping enforcement.
